github.description: GitHub MCP server — PRs, issues, files, checks, code search. Uses GitHub's hosted HTTP transport (no local install).
github.notes: GH_TOKEN must be a long-lived Personal Access Token, not a rotating gh CLI OAuth token (gh refreshes those on its own schedule, so 'export GH_TOKEN=$(gh auth token)' in your shell rc will break the next time gh rotates). Create a PAT at https://github.com/settings/tokens — classic 'repo' + 'workflow' scopes for private repos, or fine-grained equivalents (Pull requests: read/write, Issues: read/write, Contents: read, Actions: read+write). Then 'export GH_TOKEN=<pat>' in ~/.zshrc / ~/.bashrc. The 'X-MCP-Toolsets: all' header enables the GitHub MCP actions toolset (mcp__github__actions_* + get_job_logs, used by /action-run and /action-check) on top of the default PR/issue/repo tools — the hosted server doesn't enable actions by default, and the single-toolset URL form (/mcp/x/actions) would drop the PR tools check-pr needs, so the header is the way to combine them. The exposed tool surface is still gated by the PAT's real scopes (Actions: read to inspect runs, Actions: write to trigger them). ${VAR} expansion in MCP headers can be unreliable across Claude Code versions — if the server rejects auth, fall back to pre-resolving the header when registering: claude mcp add --scope <scope> --transport http github https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/ --header "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" --header "X-MCP-Toolsets: all". The same GH_TOKEN is reused by check-pr's log-fetch curl and the action-run/action-check Monitor poll, so one token covers all of them.

mcp-atlassian.notes: Cloud (atlassian.net): set JIRA_USERNAME + JIRA_API_TOKEN. Create the token at https://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens. Server / Data Center: set JIRA_PERSONAL_TOKEN (Personal Access Token from your Jira profile). Install uvx via 'curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh'.
